# TriggerX

> Free real-time crypto price alerts. Set a price target on any Binance Spot pair
> and get an email or Telegram notification the moment the market crosses it.

TriggerX watches the live Binance WebSocket feed around the clock, so no browser
tab has to stay open. Alerts support three conditions (above, below, crosses),
can be written in plain English such as "ETH below 2500" or "BTC up 10%", and
fire exactly once before moving to history. Sign-in is a one-time email code —
there is no password. Alerts are best-effort and are not a substitute for
exchange-native stop-loss or limit orders.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.triggerx.in/): Product overview, features, integrations and FAQ.
- [Sign in](https://www.triggerx.in/auth): Email one-time-code sign-in, no password.
- [Dashboard](https://www.triggerx.in/dashboard): Create and manage alerts. Requires sign-in.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.triggerx.in/privacy): What is stored and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.triggerx.in/terms): Terms of use, including alert-reliability limits.

## Docs

- [Backend source](https://github.com/Shiva-Xs/triggerx-backend): Open-source service that runs the price feed and alert engine.

## Notes

- Covers every active USDT trading pair on Binance, refreshed automatically.
- Delivery channels: email, the @TriggerX_AlertBot Telegram bot, and a Chrome extension.
- Limit of 50 active alerts per account. Free, with no ads, trackers or analytics.
